en-US.whatsNew:
Widgets now work with albums of any size and start at your first photo.

• Fixed widgets staying blank on albums with lots of photos
• Widgets in album order start at the album's first photo
• Every 6 hours and Daily now change on your local clock
• Choose No group to take a widget off its group
• Choose Whole group to show every album in a group again
• Diagnostics counts only the widgets on your Home Screen
en-US.promotionalText: Free forever. No ads, no subscriptions, no paywall, no limits. Unlimited albums, a different album on every widget, and photos that change on their own all day.
